items.name: Windows telemetry
items.summary: Collects diagnostic and usage data about this PC and sends it to Microsoft.
items.effect: Microsoft receives less data about how this PC is used. Nothing you use stops working, though Feedback Hub and Windows Insider builds may not be able to report problems.

items.name: Error reporting
items.summary: Offers to send details to Microsoft when an app crashes or stops responding.
items.effect: Windows stops offering to send crash details after an app fails. Apps still close and restart as before.

items.name: App compatibility telemetry
items.summary: Scans the programs installed on this PC and reports compatibility information to Microsoft.
items.effect: Windows stops scanning your programs for compatibility data. Updating Windows still works; Microsoft just gets less warning about apps that may not suit a new version.

items.name: Customer Experience Improvement Program
items.summary: Gathers usage statistics for Microsoft's improvement program, if you joined it.
items.effect: Usage statistics are no longer gathered. If you never joined the program, these tasks already do nothing.

items.name: Disk health reporting
items.summary: Sends general disk and system information to Microsoft for the improvement program.
items.effect: Disk information is no longer sent to Microsoft. Your drives are not affected.

items.name: Feedback requests
items.summary: Prepares the feedback questions and surveys Windows sometimes shows.
items.effect: Windows stops asking for feedback. The Feedback Hub app still works when you open it yourself.

items.name: App list for Windows Backup
items.summary: Makes a list of your installed desktop apps so Windows Backup can offer them on a new PC.
items.effect: Windows Backup may not know which desktop apps to suggest when you set up another PC.

items.name: Office telemetry
items.summary: Collects Office usage and error data for Microsoft's telemetry dashboard, mostly used by IT teams.
items.effect: Office stops gathering that data. Office itself works the same.

items.name: Recall snapshots
items.summary: Recall can save snapshots of your screen every few seconds so you can search what you saw. It stays off unless you turn it on in Settings, and it only exists on Copilot+ PCs.
items.effect: Switches on the Windows setting “Turn off saving snapshots for use with Recall”. Recall can no longer save snapshots, and Windows deletes any it saved before.

items.name: Click to Do
items.summary: Takes a screenshot when you use it and analyzes it on your PC to suggest actions. It does nothing until you open it.
items.effect: Click to Do is no longer available. Nothing else changes.

items.name: Windows AI components
items.summary: Hosts the AI components built into Windows so apps can use them on your PC.
items.effect: AI features in Windows apps may not work until you turn this back on. It stays available, so Windows can still start it for anything that asks.

items.name: Xbox services
items.summary: Xbox sign-in, cloud game saves, networking and accessory support.
items.effect: Xbox app and Game Pass games, Microsoft Store games and Xbox accessories may stop signing in or saving to the cloud. Games from other stores are not affected.

items.name: Phone Link and nearby devices
items.summary: Connects this PC with your phone and nearby devices.
items.effect: Phone Link, Nearby Sharing and casting to a wireless display may stop working until you turn this back on.

items.name: Location
items.summary: Works out where this PC is for apps and Windows features.
items.effect: Weather, maps, Find My Device and automatic time zone can't find your location until you turn this back on.

items.name: Offline maps
items.summary: Keeps maps you downloaded for offline use up to date.
items.effect: Downloaded offline maps are no longer updated by themselves. Online maps are not affected.

items.name: Wallet and NFC payments
items.summary: Supports tap-to-pay and other NFC features that use a secure chip.
items.effect: Tap-to-pay and NFC features that use a secure chip stop working. Most PCs don't have this hardware.

items.name: Retail demo mode
items.summary: Runs the demo mode used on display PCs in shops.
items.effect: Nothing changes on a normal PC.

items.name: Mobile hotspot and connection sharing
items.summary: Lets this PC share its internet connection with other devices.
items.effect: Mobile hotspot and internet connection sharing stop working until you turn this back on.

items.name: Media sharing
items.summary: Shares your music, pictures and videos with TVs and other devices on your network.
items.effect: Your media library is no longer shared with other devices on your network.

items.name: Superfetch (SysMain)
items.summary: Learns which apps you use and loads them into memory ahead of time.
items.effect: Apps may take a little longer to open, mostly on older hard drives. On a PC with an SSD you may not notice any difference.

items.name: Startup app reminders
items.summary: Shows a notice when you have a lot of startup apps.
items.effect: Windows stops reminding you about startup apps. The Startup page in TidyWindow still lists them.

items.name: Widgets
items.summary: The Widgets board and the background programs it uses (WidgetService and WidgetBoard).
items.effect: Hides the Widgets button and board and stops its background programs after you sign in again. It also removes the weather on the lock screen.

items.name: Device census
items.summary: Collects details about this PC's hardware and settings (using devicecensus.exe) and sends them to Microsoft.
items.effect: Microsoft receives fewer details about this PC. Nothing you use depends on it.

items.name: Program Compatibility Assistant
items.summary: Watches for older programs that have trouble running and offers compatibility fixes, and keeps its list of known problems up to date.
items.effect: Windows stops offering to fix older programs and games that fail to start or install. Programs you already run are not affected.

items.name: Bluetooth
items.summary: Finds and connects Bluetooth devices such as headphones, keyboards, mice, speakers and phones.
items.effect: Every Bluetooth device stops working, including a Bluetooth keyboard or mouse, until you turn this back on. Only turn it off if this PC has no Bluetooth devices you use.

items.name: Network device discovery (UPnP)
items.summary: Lets this PC find smart TVs, media players and other gadgets on your network, and lets them find it.
items.effect: Apps may not find TVs or media devices on your network for casting or streaming, and some routers' automatic port setup stops working. Normal internet, file sharing and printing are not affected.

items.name: Remote management (WinRM)
items.summary: Lets other computers run PowerShell commands and manage this PC over the network.
items.effect: Nobody can manage this PC remotely with PowerShell remoting or similar tools. PowerShell on this PC works as before.

items.name: Remote Registry
items.summary: Lets other computers read and change this PC's registry over the network. Windows ships it turned off.
items.effect: Nothing changes on a normal PC. Keep it off unless an IT tool you use needs it.

items.name: Scanners and camera import
items.summary: Runs scanners and lets Windows import photos from cameras and phones (Windows Image Acquisition).
items.effect: Scanners, and importing photos from some cameras, stop working until you turn this back on. Printing is not affected.

items.name: Sensors
items.summary: Reads the sensors in laptops and tablets, such as auto-rotate, ambient light and orientation.
items.effect: Auto-rotate, automatic brightness and other sensor features may stop working. A desktop PC without sensors won't notice.

items.name: Smart cards and security keys
items.summary: Supports smart card readers and some security keys, such as work ID cards and certificate-based sign-in.
items.effect: Smart card readers and the security keys that use them stop working for sign-in until you turn this back on. Passwords, PINs and Windows Hello are not affected.

items.name: Offline Files and Work Folders
items.summary: Keeps copies of network folders and Work Folders on this PC so you can use them offline.
items.effect: Files from network shares marked “always available offline”, and Work Folders from an employer or school, stop syncing. Most home PCs don't use either.

items.name: Family Safety (parental controls)
items.summary: Applies Microsoft Family time limits, app limits and web filtering to child accounts on this PC.
items.effect: Screen-time limits and web filtering stop being applied to child accounts on this PC. Only turn this off if nobody here is managed with Microsoft Family.

items.name: Windows Insider Program
items.summary: Receives test builds of Windows if you joined the Insider Program.
items.effect: This PC stops receiving Insider preview builds and can't join the program. Normal Windows updates are not affected.

items.name: Game recording and broadcasting
items.summary: Lets Windows record your screen in the background while you play (Game Bar clips and “record what happened”) and broadcast it.
items.effect: Game Bar can't record or broadcast. Other screen recorders, such as OBS, are not affected.

items.name: Recommended troubleshooting
items.summary: Scans this PC in the background and quietly applies fixes that Microsoft recommends for problems it finds.
items.effect: Windows stops scanning for problems and applying fixes by itself. Troubleshooters you start from Settings still work.

items.name: Notepad AI
items.summary: The AI rewrite, summarize and write features built into Notepad.
items.effect: The AI buttons and menus disappear from Notepad. Notepad opens, edits and saves files exactly as before.

items.name: Paint AI
items.summary: Cocreator, Generative Fill and Image Creator in Paint.
items.effect: Paint no longer offers Cocreator, Generative Fill or Image Creator. Drawing and editing in Paint are not affected.

items.name: Sharing updates with other PCs
items.summary: Lets Windows use your internet connection and disk to send pieces of updates and Store apps to other PCs (Delivery Optimization peer-to-peer).
items.effect: Windows Update and the Store still download as normal, straight from Microsoft. Updates may arrive a little slower on a network where several PCs would have shared them. Settings shows this as managed.

items.name: Network while the PC sleeps
items.summary: On laptops and other PCs with Modern Standby, Windows keeps Wi-Fi connected while the PC sleeps, which wakes it for background traffic and drains the battery.
items.effect: Wi-Fi may disconnect while the PC sleeps, so email, messages and downloads wait until you wake it. Sleep itself is not affected. This only changes PCs that use Modern Standby.

items.name: Search highlights
items.summary: Downloads the daily pictures, holidays and trending topics shown in the search box and Start menu search.
items.effect: Search stops showing daily pictures and trending topics. Searching for your files and apps works as before.

items.name: Windows hardware benchmark
items.summary: Runs the Windows System Assessment Tool, a benchmark that stresses the processor, graphics, memory and disk while the PC is idle.
items.effect: Windows stops running its hardware benchmark by itself. A few programs that read its scores may show out-of-date ones.

items.name: Speech model downloads
items.summary: Checks for and downloads speech recognition models in the background, even if you never use voice typing.
items.effect: Speech models are no longer downloaded or updated by themselves. Voice typing and speech recognition may need a manual download the next time you use them.

items.name: Remote install from the Store
items.summary: Lets the Microsoft Store website install apps on this PC when you choose “Install on my devices”.
items.effect: “Install on my devices” on the Store website can no longer install apps on this PC. Installing from the Store app on this PC is not affected.

items.name: Find My Device
items.summary: Registers this PC and its location with your Microsoft account so you can find it if it is lost or stolen.
items.effect: You can't locate this PC from your Microsoft account, and it stops sending its location there. Apps that use location on this PC are not affected.

items.name: Fax and printer notifications
items.summary: Fax, and the service that lets printer apps show notices such as low ink or a paper jam, plus a task for school print setup.
items.effect: Fax stops working, and printer apps may not show ink or paper notices. Printing itself is not affected.

items.name: GameInput service
items.summary: Supports the GameInput interface that some games and apps use to read controllers and other game devices.
items.effect: Games and apps that use GameInput may not see your controller or other game devices until you turn this back on. Most games use other ways to read controllers.
